version.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

llm.summary: The skill is a coherent Google Sheets integration, but it asks users to install and allowlist an unpinned third-party plugin that handles Google OAuth and spreadsheet reads/writes.

dimensions.detail: Access to spreadsheets in the connected Google account is proportionate to the purpose, but the data may include sensitive personal or business content and the effective OAuth scope is not fully detailed in the skill text.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup installs `clawhub:clawlink-plugin`, allowlists it in OpenClaw, and restarts the gateway, but the artifact does not pin a version or digest or provide auditable plugin source for the OAuth-mediated component.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly separates read and write operations and instructs the agent to preview and confirm write, destructive, and batch operations before execution.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The plugin allowlist change persists beyond the current chat, and ClawLink stores OAuth tokens for continued use; this is disclosed but lacks equally clear uninstall, revocation, token retention, and containment guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Google Sheets automation, and the listed capabilities are aligned: spreadsheet discovery, reading cell data, writing values, clearing data, sheet management, charts, filters, validation, and creation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this before installing: it will connect a Google account through ClawLink, allow spreadsheet reads, and enable confirmed writes or destructive changes. Install only if you trust the ClawLink plugin source, verify the Google consent screen and requested scopes, require previews before writes, and know how to revoke the Google connection and remove the plugin if you stop using it.
llm.findings: [T08] expected: The external ClawLink plugin and managed OAuth flow are expected for this Google Sheets integration, and the artifact discloses them. The concern remains valid in context because the installed plugin is referenced by a mutable package name while being placed in a sensitive OAuth and spreadsheet mutation boundary.
